words.ex: Hvordan går det? – Det går bra!
words.ex_tr: How are you? – I’m fine!

words.ex: Beklager! – Ingen fare.
words.ex_tr: Sorry! – No problem.

words.ex: Ta det med ro, vi rekker det.
words.ex_tr: Take it easy, we’ll make it.

words.ex: Kaffe eller te? – Det spiller ingen rolle.
words.ex_tr: Coffee or tea? – It doesn’t matter.

words.ex: Kommer du? – Det kommer an på været.
words.ex_tr: Are you coming? – It depends on the weather.

words.ex: Kan du hjelpe meg? – Så klart!
words.ex_tr: Can you help me? – Of course!

words.ex: Kos deg på ferien!
words.ex_tr: Enjoy your holiday!

words.ex: Lykke til på prøven!
words.ex_tr: Good luck with the test!

words.ex: God bedring, håper du blir frisk snart!
words.ex_tr: Get well soon, I hope you recover quickly!

words.ex: Gratulerer med dagen, Kari!
words.ex_tr: Happy birthday, Kari!

words.ex: Det er synd at du ikke kan komme.
words.ex_tr: It’s a pity you can’t come.

words.ex: Alt er i orden.
words.ex_tr: Everything is all right.

words.ex: Kan vi møtes i morgen? – Helt greit.
words.ex_tr: Can we meet tomorrow? – That’s fine.

words.ex: Ikke vær redd, det ordner seg.
words.ex_tr: Don’t worry, it will work out.

words.ex: Du ser trist ut. Hva er i veien?
words.ex_tr: You look sad. What’s wrong?

words.ex: Jeg er helt enig med deg.
words.ex_tr: I completely agree with you.

words.ex: Det er på tide å gå hjem.
words.ex_tr: It’s time to go home.

words.ex: Du lærer det etter hvert.
words.ex_tr: You will learn it eventually.

words.ex: Skål for brudeparet!
words.ex_tr: Cheers to the bride and groom!

words.ex: Takk for maten! – Velbekomme!
words.ex_tr: Thanks for the meal! – You’re welcome!

words.ex: Det var en gang en konge.
words.ex_tr: Once upon a time there was a king.

words.ex: Du kom! Bedre sent enn aldri.
words.ex_tr: You came! Better late than never.
